title: GraphSmith per-skill capability grant (R1)
description: The GRANTED resource envelope for one skill, per resource class (filesystem / model / subprocess / network). Enforcement checks requested ⊆ granted BEFORE execution and halts on violation. C2-binding (D1 honesty line): a resource class is only listed in `enforced` if the running engine actually enforces it this release; the GSA capability attestation may attest ONLY enforced classes — never a boundary that isn't enforced. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.4.0).

grants.description: The granted envelope per class. Absent class => nothing granted for it (deny-by-default).

read.description: Allowed read path prefixes (canonical, no traversal).

destinations.description: Allowed destination host allowlist (the v0.3.0-enforced class).

enforced.description: The resource classes actually ENFORCED by the running engine this release. Only these may be attested in the GSA capabilities.grants result. A class in `grants` but not in `enforced` is declared, NOT attested (fail-closed honesty — never vouch for an unenforced boundary).
